c1_fact: Exposes Node.js API (programmatic, lighthouse function) and CLI (Node.js tool via npm). Does NOT expose an MCP server. Callable from TypeScript via Node.js API.
c2_fact: Can run headless. Launches its own Chrome instance (via chrome-launcher + puppeteer-core). Suitable for GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest. No external infrastructure needed.
c4_fact: npm package. Key deps: chrome-launcher, puppeteer-core. Install size and setup time dependent on Node.js packages. Relatively standard npm tool.
